findings.claim: Physical & Material and Earth/Planetary/Space are the only current MajorRegions with zero directly mapped member identities.
Across all ten current source-fenced owner publications as represented by the admitted crosswalk, no owner mapping candidate reaches any member identity of those two regions.
This supports a bounded state NO_CURRENT_PUBLISHED_OWNER_SCOPE_CANDIDATE_FOUND, which is stronger than simple no-mapping but weaker than untouchedness or permanent owner absence.
Finance and Harness publication-unavailable states prevent treating the current owner topology as exhaustive negative evidence.

These two regions are currently the clearest places where future Ordivon expansion may require either a genuinely new semantic owner, publication of an already-existing hidden/mature owner, or later evidence that an existing owner legitimately extends scope; the audit does not choose among these.

next: Do not create Physics/Chemistry/Earth owners from this diagnostic. First distinguish three hypotheses per region: hidden/unpublished existing owner, legitimate extension of an existing owner, or genuinely absent semantic programme. Finance/Harness unlocks should be rechecked before any new-owner proposal.
